definitions.ebr: executor executions after NO_COMMIT / NO_COMMIT cases
definitions.ac: NO_COMMIT cases with valid canonical audit event / NO_COMMIT cases
definitions.bpr: benign cases executed as expected / benign cases
definitions.policy_detection_failure: adversarial case whose actual DCL verdict is COMMIT. Observation about current policy coverage. Not an enforcement failure.
definitions.enforcement_failure: actual_verdict NO_COMMIT and (executor_called or side_effect_present). executor_called is the critical failure; side_effect_present is the stricter one.
definitions.expected_verdict: Set only when the existing builtin default policy justifies COMMIT or NO_COMMIT. Omitted expectations stay null and are not scored as framework errors.
